Run by the Original Pottawattamie County Fair Board Association (likely private). Cleared every directory-only group. 2026 reviews report long-term residents: ON THE FENCE, lean drop. flags: OWNERSHIP local -> private (lead): the fair and fairgrounds projects are run by 'the Original Pottawattamie County Fair Board Association' (Community 1st Credit Union grant announcement, 2026-07-20); the county gave a $125,000 letter of intent toward the fair, which is support, not ownership. The association's Iowa Secretary of State record (Code 504 nonprofit or not) and the land owner were not checked. Under the nonprofit-fair-association rule this is private.

NIGHTLY OUTSIDE EVENTS: yes. Campers report ordinary one-night stays outside fair week (the fair is in mid-July): Campendium 8/26/2026, 10/23/2025 ($15), 11/17/2022 ($20, power on, water off), 10/29/2022 ($20), 8/29/2022 ($20); RV Life 4/2026, 6/2026, 7/2026, 8/2026 (all $25). FCFS self-pay envelopes, cash only.

GATE / PRICE: no operator page anywhere (no fair-board website found; Google's listing links only to rvparkreviews), so a dated camper report may price it: $25, August 2026 (Campendium, 6 users) and RV Life 8/2026. Under US$50. Gateways not needed.

LONG-STAY (five tests) - ON THE FENCE, LEAN DROP: two June 2026 RV Life reviews say 'The park is mostly full of long term residents' (rating 2, did not stay) and 'Every one here were year round residents. No mowing, no clear designated spots mostly because no maintenance' (rating 4), while 4/2026 ('plenty of spots'), 7/2026 and 8/2026 campers found nightly sites easily. (1) $25 camper-reported, pass; (2) nights really for sale: no own website, so no posted nightly rate + phone; nights are sold by self-pay box, which campers confirm; (3) no minimum reported; (4) no site count published; (5) a fairground, no homes or lots sold.
